commits.purpose: Add deterministic 32-ring swept LOD0 crescent-lever asset refinement with exact topology/UV validation and formal-epoch dependency-hash freeze.
Add technical lookdev illustration covering silhouette, cross-section, installation interfaces and required rendered evidence.
Add machine-readable manufacture/installation/PBR/LOD/evidence contract for the smooth crescent refinement.
Update parent sash-latch metadata so LOD0 construction reasoning describes the continuous swept lever instead of the superseded six-box approximation.
Bind curve preparation and read-only validation into the central reflection-lighting fingerprint before parent latch preparation.
Upgrade the reflection physicality contract to require smooth-curve coherence before request, during poll/completion and before still capture.

problemSelected: The existing physical sash-latch pass replaced generic rubber handles, but its LOD0 crescent lever was still assembled from six overlapping chamfered boxes at angles -65/-39/-13/+13/+39/+65 degrees. At a 100-percent native-4K sash crop or grazing light this can create a visible staircase silhouette and discontinuous highlight travel. Because visible primitive-like faceting, aliasing and implausible material response directly threaten Geometry, Material/PBR, Lighting and Temporal categories, refining this known hero-detail weakness was higher value than adding a new unrelated asset.

constructionReasoning.manufacture: Model one continuous swept hard-surface operating lever around the existing pivot, with broad faces and a geometric corner break. Do not claim exact historical product identity.
constructionReasoning.dimensionsThickness: Retain the parent 34 mm centerline radius and reconstruct a 130 degree sweep, 10 x 10 mm section and 2 mm corner break. Use 32 arc rings for LOD0. The 50 mm mounting pitch remains the only product/period-supported dimension in the parent assembly; the refined lever section remains a benchmark assumption.
constructionReasoning.materialsFinish: Reuse MAT_AgedAluminum and its metallic/roughness/normal response; no new material, emission or painted highlight. Contracted envelope: baseColor sRGB approximately [0.55,0.57,0.56], metallic 0.5-1.0, roughness 0.38-0.72, normalScale 0.08, microstructure about 0.45 mm, wetness 0.
constructionReasoning.mountingInterfaces: Keep the existing renderer transform, pivot, base plate, receiver, fasteners and weathering component. The curve must clear meeting-stile, glazing gasket and optical glass, and remain mechanically legible against the receiver.
constructionReasoning.orientationExposure: Sheltered vertical sash hardware under coherent midsummer sun/sky/reflection fill. Grazing evidence is required specifically because a smooth real curve should carry a continuous BRDF highlight rather than six discrete box responses.
constructionReasoning.aging: No new arbitrary dirt is generated. Parent sheltered/recessed grime, UV/oxide dulling and localized hand-contact polish remain authoritative.
constructionReasoning.geometryVsMaterial: Centerline curve, section thickness, 2 mm corner break and cap shape are geometry. Oxidation, micro-scratches, 0.45 mm microstructure and contact polish remain material response.
constructionReasoning.lod: Only LOD0 geometry is refined. Parent LOD1/2/3 and cross-fade thresholds remain unchanged so temporal evidence must still prove that LOD0-to-LOD1 simplification does not pop or shimmer.

implementation.formalEvidencePolicy: The central reflection fingerprint calls QualityBlockSashLatchCurveRefinement.EnsurePreparedForFormalEvidence before QualityBlockFacadeSashLatchUpgrade.EnsurePreparedForFormalEvidence. First call may create/repair deterministic curve assets, records AssetDatabase dependency hashes and arms the epoch. Subsequent reflection fingerprints and MainCamera culls validate exact vertices/UV/triangle order/topology and fail closed on dependency-hash drift instead of repairing in flight.

verification.githubSourceReview: PASS for repository write/readback and formal binding structure.
verification.topologyArithmetic: PASS by static arithmetic: 32 rings x 9 side vertices plus two 9-vertex end-cap sets = 306 vertices; 31 intervals x 8 sides x 2 triangles plus 16 cap triangles = 512 triangles.
verification.physicalBoundsArithmetic: PASS by static calculation: expected lever mesh bounds are approximately 26.72 mm x 70.69 mm x 10.00 mm and remain within the source QA envelope.
verification.reflectionOrdering: PASS by source review: smooth curve preparation occurs before parent latch formal preparation in the central reflection-material binding, then both are revalidated at the same fingerprint boundary.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Geometry & construction fidelity: potentially improves the hero sash hardware silhouette by replacing a six-piece approximation with one continuous swept manufactured form. No score until rendered.
Material/PBR physical plausibility: potentially removes six independent box-edge highlight discontinuities while preserving the same canonical aged-metal material. No score until rendered.

Lighting/shadows/reflections: potentially produces continuous grazing highlight travel and more coherent contact/self-shadowing; formal reflection fingerprint now binds the curve state. No score until rendered.
Texture/microdetail: physical-metre UVs remain deterministic across eight 11 mm phase variants and the cross-section seam has explicit UV continuity. No score until rendered.

Temporal/LOD/aliasing: denser LOD0 curvature may reduce silhouette stair-stepping but could also introduce new subpixel sparkle; parent LOD1 remains substantially simpler, so temporal evidence is mandatory. No score until rendered.
renderRisksToInspect: 32 arc rings may still facet under extreme 100-percent crop/grazing light; do not assume source topology is sufficient.
The reconstructed 10 x 10 mm lever section may read too heavy or too thin relative to the actual sash; correct from pixels rather than defending the assumption.
The 2 mm corner break may make the edge highlight too broad or too sharp under the canonical midsummer lighting/material response.
The existing LOD1 proxy remains much simpler than the new LOD0 curve and may cause visible cross-fade shape change or shimmer.
Pivot/receiver/glazing-gasket clearance remains a pixel-level intersection check despite source-side dimensions.
Metric UV phase variation does not prove repetition is invisible; the 100-percent crop and temporal motion remain authoritative.
